text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At summer training camp—days of rigorous training
continued in preparation for the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? Is that—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Ruler, Flash-senpai—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: And then, there is Pisa, is there?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
This took place earlier this morning, but—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Mmm—
Is it... morning...?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Good morning,
Rose-san.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Flash-senpai.
...You are up quite early.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I awaken an hour earlier than usual in order to prepare nutritional provisions for training and handle other necessary duties.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Is that so?
I was not aware—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (... Pisa and Ruler are already nowhere to be seen.)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
What does it look like?—Building a simulation.
The summer training camp ought to be conducted with maximum efficiency.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Just a light beach run.
I wanted to get my body moving early.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was, as if it were only natural,
working tirelessly toward victory.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I straightened my posture without even realizing it.
Like them, I must keep my standards high at all times.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even before the Japanese Derby, she had spoken of her rivals.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
And yet, in this arena,
I am by no means the sole power.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Their strength taught me that lesson.
This realization will surely nourish my growth henceforth.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If running alongside her rivals has had such a positive effect on her—
choice_data_list: （もっと何か、関わりを設けたい）

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Take a breather together with your peers?
choice_data_list: 次回のオフなどで、いかがでしょうか

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I see.
—Fascinating.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Specifically, what kind of plan do you have in mind?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
A summer festival, is it—
What they call an ennichi fair, I presume.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I shall speak to them myself.
Thank you for the suggestion.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Bang! Click... bang!*)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh, that's roughly how it goes.
A humble offering for you, Your Majesty.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Ah—thank you. A splendid display of skill.
Do you, by chance, have some experience with marksmanship?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, at the elementary school I attended,
you could earn a junior marksmanship certification.
I was one of the top gunslingers in the whole school.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: So that was it...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: I am merely jesting.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Everyone, I brought back some yakisoba, grilled squid... and a treat called Gebrannte Mandeln.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
My, these are German confections...!
Their standard distribution period is the Christmas season.
Encountering them at this time is an exceptional case.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I was curious to know what it tastes like.
Let's head over there and eat it together with everyone.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Delicious. A touch heavy on the sauce, perhaps, but no—
that very excess imparts the true charm of festival street food.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Lecker...
Japanese street stall food is truly wonderful as well.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Shall we unwrap the grilled squid too?
I hear it's from a shop quite famous in the old downtown.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...How did it taste to you, Rose-san?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...
Yeah, that was delicious.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: It was surprisingly delicious.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Fireworks—splendid. Even within the Rose Clan,
we sometimes view fireworks during the summer.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I shall speak to them myself.
Thank you for the suggestion.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: By fireworks—do you mean handheld fireworks?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Gunpowder is wrapped inside the tip,
and upon ignition, a shower of sparks bursts forth.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...Has gunpowder been packed inside?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Rest assured. By law, the amount of gunpowder
in Japan must not exceed 15 grams.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hey now, the candle's going to blow out again.
Try lighting just one first.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Clap... clap-clap-clap!*)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...! The fire is quite close, after all.
Yet—it possesses a distinct charm, entirely unlike skyrocket fireworks.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. You can even draw pictures in the air with the lingering light trails.
Look.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, please be careful.
Rose-san, would you care to try a sparkler?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Yes, let us try.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Shall we make it a contest of endurance time?
When I held one with Falcon-san previously,
it proved to be quite an exhilarating match.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
A sparkler endurance match—which means our luck,
composure, and technical finesse will all be put to the test.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. How beautiful.
A light shining in the dark night... Ah.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Mine dropped off as well.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh, how naive, Pisa, Flash-san.
True durability means—Aaaah! It collapsed!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Damn it... Rose Kingdom is the victor. Congratulations, Your Majesty.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, hahaha!
Ah, I am honored. ...Truly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer.
This has become a truly wonderful summer memory.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
At this rate,
it might even turn into an unforgettable summer.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I want to push myself even harder for the autumn.
I must run in a way that brings no shame before them.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Through interacting with her peers, Rose Kingdom seemed more motivated than ever.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking ahead to the upcoming Kikuka Sho,
the days of summer training camp only grew more intense.
